newsitem.title: USA: Corvas names John Fried chairman.
newsitem.headline: Corvas names John Fried chairman.

text.p: Corvas International Inc on Friday said it has named John Fried, replacing David Kabakoff, who has been chairman since January 1996.
Kabakoff also had been chief executive officer of Corvas until May 1996 when he left to assume the position of executive vice president of Dura Pharmaceuticals Inc.
Fried, 67, has been a director and consultant to Corvas since 1992. He also is chairman of Alexion Pharmaceuticals and president of Fried & Company Inc, a consulting firm.

"The additional commitment from (Fried) will be valuable in view of his experience in business and in drug development for larger pharmaceutical companies," Randall Woods, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
